calibration.pitch_tracking_scope: 0..5 V at 25 C after factory calibration; target only, not guaranteed by resistor tolerance. #29 defines sweep and temperature characterization.
calibration.pitch_voltage_error_caveat: 5 cents at 1 V/oct equals 4.166667 mV; oscillator exponential/core error and temperature must share this total budget. A 2 mV octave-step target alone does not prove five-octave tracking.
calibration.sample_hold: No long-hold pitch accuracy promise; characterize droop separately from output load error.

connections: DC feedback senses JACK through 100 ohm R_FB; 1 nF high-frequency feedback returns locally from DRIVE to FB.
notes: Fixed 100 ohm JACK feedback and 1 nF local feedback are TI OPAx197 model-screened compensation choices, not hardware stability proof. Exact identities are Yageo RC0603FR-07100RL (100 ohm, 1%, 0.1 W at 70 C) and KEMET C0603C102J5GACTU (1 nF, 5%, 50 V, C0G). Physical stability, tolerance, thermal/fault duty and factory assembly remain unqualified.
DC load-induced error target <=1 mV for -5/0/+5 V, no load to 10 kohm; full static path error target <=2 mV after factory calibration.

TI-model sweep: open/10k/100k loads and 0/100p/1n/5n F cable loads, +/-5 V steps; require no sustained oscillation, <=10% overshoot and settle within 1 mV by 1 ms. Physical cable, PCB parasitics, component tolerances and temperature require qualification.
Feedback stays on the jack board with output cell; no long unsensed feedback net across connectors.

Two series 499 ohm / 0.5 W resistors realize 998 ohm nominal. A continuous external ±12 V fault against the opposite output rail gives 24.05 mA and 0.289 W per resistor at nominal rails; qualify IC thermal dissipation.
verification: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 model sweep in #49; physical cable and layout stability remain NOT RUN.
